method: Independent same-layer copper geometry contacts using Shapely, 1 nm contact tolerance; plated barrels connected across declared layers; seven declared component-internal metal connections applied. Only directly wired source terminals count as routing requirements. Source net metadata specifies required groups and names shorts, never joins copper.
limitations: No manufacturing tolerance, impedance, power integrity, firmware or silicon functional validation.
Copper disks include plated drill interiors; this can conservatively report an overlap where another copper object crosses a drill void.
Curves are the saved route/polygon tessellations.
